summary: An article examining whether sustainable fish feed and aquaculture practices live up to their environmental claims. BioMar is mentioned as a producer in the sector but is not the primary focus of the investigation.
title: Sustainable fish feed: could Aquaculture be too good to be true?

summary: BioMar has recruited a market director for salmon feed from Hendrix Genetics. The appointment reflects staffing changes within BioMar's salmon division.
title: BioMar henter markedsdirektør for laks fra Hendrix Genetics
